integrity_statement: The stated finite classification follows exact integer extremal envelopes and a reproducible independent pair enumeration. No external validation or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classification restricted to finite integer census profiles of equal total size and Hill orders 0, 2, infinity.
No universal claim about arbitrary real Hill-order crossings or survey-coverage inference.
Primary full texts of Hill (1973) and Patil–Taillie (1982) were not available for full comparison; bibliographic originality requires independent review.
title: Fourteen individuals are the sharp three-index diversity-ranking reversal threshold
